title: OPSC Junior Assistant (JA) 2024 — English Grammar
subtitle: Paper-I Section-A Objective • 20 MCQs • Official PYQ

questions.questionText: Fill in the blank with appropriate tense: Neither of the paintings ______ sold.
Choose the passive voice for the following sentence: Please maintain silence in this room.
options: Let silence be maintained in this room
There shall be silence in this room
Please remain silent in this room

questions.questionText: Choose the passive voice for the following sentence: They are painting their house.
options: They shall be painting their house

questions.questionText: Fill in the blank with the appropriate modal verb: I ______ read without my reading glasses. Where are they?
Choose the grammatically correct sentence from the following:
options: When you told him the story?
I am watching this serial for two years' now.
He is having many pens in his pocket.
She told her name after coming home.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct infinitive for the following sentence: Are you ready ______ now?
Choose the correct conjunction for the following sentence: He was late ______ the bus did not come.
Use the correct phrase for the following sentence: Children ______ play every evening.
Choose the correct word and fill in the blank: She was wearing a bangle ______.
Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions: He climbed ______ the ladder to get ______ the roof.
'Cool as a cucumber' means:
Fill in the blank with the correct article: What ______ huge mountain!
Choose the correct reported speech for the following sentence: She said, "I'll phone you tomorrow".
options: She said that she would phone tomorrow
She said I shall phone you tomorrow
She told him to phone tomorrow
She said she would phone me the next day

questions.questionText: Use the superlative form of the adjective given in brackets: Nayana is the ______ (pretty) girl in the class.
Use the appropriate determiner for the following sentence: Have you seen ______ MP3 player anywhere?
Choose the correct answer for the question given below: Can you swim?
'Your mother is cooking in the kitchen.' Tick the correct question from the following:
options: What is your mother cooking in the kitchen?

questions.questionText: Choose the appropriate preposition for the following sentence: She was hiding ______ the table.
Spot the incorrect sentence from the following:
options: It takes me an hour to visit the temple.
It is an honour to serve you.

questions.questionText: Spot the correct sentence from the following:
options: I bought four dozens of apples.
